name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Seven eliminations, one game, a Miami record. Cassius, does one night make a career, or just a headline?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, Renee, a headline’s cheap but this one’s a chemical reaction...shiftin’ the whole Miami paintball DNA. Tass didn’t just show up, he stamped the blueprint for greatness.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Now, Cassius, I hear you, but one incredible performance, even a record-setting seven eliminations, doesn't rewrite the entire history book, does it?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, Andrew, I get the caution but listen...no one else even came close to seven in one go. That’s not just history rewritten, that’s history erased and upgraded.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Cassius, 'greatest ever' is a career claim. What you've got is one night, one field, one record. So which are we actually voting on here, a legacy or a box score?

name: CASSIUS WYNN
line: Ayo, Renee, one night with seven eliminations is a career statement in this game...Miami’s crown ain’t just about years, it’s about moments that redefine the throne. You want legacy?
